title: Harder reasoning question
about: Partial return arithmetic across an order's items, delivery charge and policy windows.

turns.say: On order 45102 I bought a stand mixer and a bowl set. If I return just the bowl set unopened and keep the mixer, how much do I get back, and is any of the delivery charge refunded?
And if the mixer turned out to be faulty 40 days after delivery, what would my options be then?
